statement: AMD has committed to a strategic equity investment of up to $5 billion in Anthropic alongside the GPU deployment agreement.
why: Vendor equity flowing to a large accelerator buyer is a form of supplier-funded demand, so part of the announced purchase capacity rests on the vendor's own balance sheet rather than independent buyer financing.

impact.mechanism: Vendor investment improves the buyer's ability to fund compute, supporting near-term demand while making that demand partly dependent on continued vendor financing.

evidence.excerpt: AMD has committed to make a strategic equity investment of up to $5 billion in Anthropic.

confidence.basis: Primary vendor press release stating the commitment; the release surfaced no revenue or purchase-commitment dollar figure.
